name: navigator-agent-builder-surface-coherence
body:
The distributed `codebase-navigator` prompt `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` accounts for the `agent-builder`'s main-write surface by REFERENCE over RESTATEMENT: it points at the agent-builder's own definition (`opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`) as the authoritative enumeration of that surface, and states only what the NAVIGATOR needs operationally.

The navigator prompt points at the agent-builder's own definition for the full surface, carrying the reference instead of a subset that ages. (Symmetry: the agents-md hygiene law's process-ownership rule makes the navigator the sole owner of the canonical change-set process; the agent-builder owns the enumeration of its own write surface.)

Required behaviour:
- REFERENCE OVER RESTATEMENT: the navigator prompt points at the agent-builder's own definition for the surface enumeration.
- NAVIGATOR-OPERATIONAL: it states what the navigator does — when code-writer agents are missing or outdated it tasks the `agent-builder` on the MAIN checkout, the agent-builder commits there, then the navigator rebases the project worktree onto main, re-scans the worktree, and the user restarts opencode and reconnects before implementation continues.
- SURFACE COVERAGE: that delegation covers the repo-root `AGENTS.md` hygiene and the `opencode.json` agent→model map ALONGSIDE the `.opencode/agents/**` scaffold, so the navigator knows the maintenance spans all three carve-out-1 paths.
- SCOPING: the main-checkout scoping names all three carve-out-1 paths (the `.opencode/agents/**` scaffold, the `opencode.json` model map, and the repo-root `AGENTS.md` hygiene), retains the optional consented `release-agent` as the other agent carve-out, and states the agent carve-out count as two.

Acceptance criteria:
- The prompt states the full surface at every spot: the agent-builder's write grant/surface spans the `.opencode/agents/**` scaffold, the `opencode.json` model map, and the repo-root `AGENTS.md` hygiene.
- The prompt references the agent-builder's own definition for the full surface, and states the delegation covers the `.opencode/agents/**` scaffold, the `opencode.json` model map, and the repo-root `AGENTS.md` hygiene.
- The on-main → commit → rebase-worktree → re-scan → user-restart-opencode flow is stated, and the main-checkout mutation boundary scopes to the binary's node/edge/plan/review mutations, free of the delegation.
- Scope is the one product-source file `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`; `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` sit outside this requirement.
